description: Header file defining the D3D11VideoDecoder class, a Windows GPU video decoder using Direct3D 11, including class declarations, method signatures, and member variables.

classes.name: D3D11VideoDecoder
classes.description: A Windows GPU video decoder class utilizing Direct3D 11, supporting initialization, decoding, and output management, with internal state tracking and GPU resource handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new D3D11VideoDecoder instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetDecoderType
methods.description: Returns the type of the decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with given configuration and callbacks.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Indicates if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Checks if the decoder can read without stalling.

methods.name: GetMaxDecodeRequests
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of decode requests supported.

methods.name: UpdateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for a picture buffer.

methods.name: OutputResult
methods.description: Outputs the decoding result for a picture.

methods.name: GetD3D11FeatureLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the D3D11 feature level supported by the device.

methods.name: GetSupportedVideoDecoderConfigs
methods.description: Returns supported video decoder configurations based on preferences and device capabilities.
